# An arrow, tip at the origin, pointing -Y: slate head, peach shaft, crimson and white fletching.
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Head --base-color 0.3765 0.4235 0.5059 --no-slot
material new Shaft --base-color 0.9686 0.7137 0.6196 --no-slot
material new Fletch --base-color 0.7882 0.1412 0.3922 --no-slot
material new Nock --base-color 1.0000 1.0000 1.0000 --no-slot
add mesh cone --name Head --vertices 4 --radius1 0.09 --radius2 0 --depth 0.18 --location 0 -0.09 0 --rotation 90 0 0
material assign Head
add mesh cube --name Shaft --size 1 --location 0 0.52 0
scale 0.08 0.72 0.08
apply --scale
material assign Shaft
add mesh cube --name Fletch --size 1 --location 0 0.84 0
scale 0.05 0.24 0.18
apply --scale
material assign Fletch
add mesh cube --name Fletch2 --size 1 --location 0 0.84 0
scale 0.18 0.24 0.05
apply --scale
material assign Fletch
add mesh cube --name Nock --size 1 --location 0 0.99 0
scale 0.1 0.06 0.1
apply --scale
material assign Nock
select all
shade flat
export arrow.glb
